structure.NodeId: A canonical UUIDv7 identifier that distinguishes a Node.

Node.description: A distinct thing represented in the organizational graph.

Connection.description: A typed link declaring how Nodes relate within the organizational graph.

reality.Timestamp: A timezone-qualified point on the timeline.
reality.PositiveDuration: A strictly positive length of elapsed time.
reality.NonNegativeDuration: A length of elapsed time that cannot precede its origin.

TemporalExtentKind.value: A temporal extent occupying one point.
A temporal extent continuing for positive time.

Instant.description: A temporal extent occupying one point on the timeline.

Interval.description: A temporal extent beginning at one point and continuing for positive time.

reality.TemporalExtent: The exhaustive temporal forms an occurrence can occupy.

Entity.description: A particular thing whose identity persists as its conditions and associations change.

reality.RelationId: A canonical UUIDv7 identifier that distinguishes a Relation.

Relation.description: An identifiable domain association from one Node to another.

Memorialization.description: The creation of a durable memorial by one organizational Node after an occurrence.

Event.description: A durable memorial of one organizational occurrence.

Causation.description: A Relation declaring that one Event caused another Event.

Role.description: An organizational capacity through which an Entity acts.

Goal.description: An intended State toward which action is directed.

Action.description: Intentional activity performed or attempted by an Entity through a Role toward a Goal.

meaning.Concept: The meaning of a declaration and its alignment to other declarations.

Context.description: The States under which meaning or action applies.

Rule.description: A declaration determining whether an Action is required, permitted, or prohibited within a Context.
